question: Were tasks and reference answers checked?
checked_means: coverage, findings and limits of the check reported

applicability.reason: Every task has hidden tests and a reference patch, so checking tasks and reference answers is relevant to all 21 tasks.

check.procedure: Three checks. (1) The benchmark authors (OpenAI with the SWE-bench authors, 2024) had three engineers label each of 1,699 samples for underspecified issues and for FAIL_TO_PASS tests that may reject valid solutions, and kept 500; they report 68.3% filtered and call the filter overzealous. (2) OpenAI in 2026 audited 138 Verified problems not solved by o3 and found 59.4% with material test or description flaws, naming sympy__sympy-18199. (3) The study's auditor (Claude Code models) ran each of the 21 tasks in its image with the code before the fix (every FAIL_TO_PASS test fails) and with the real fix (every test passes), and ran a counterexample on sympy__sympy-18199.
check.evidence_location: paper2/preparation/protocol-4/eligibility/ (21 records, status eligible, no reasons) and paper2/preparation/protocol-4/audit_checks/b05-18199-counterexample.json
check.detection_limits: The authors' annotation records are not in the saved sources, so the labels for these 21 tasks were not read. The 2026 audit covers tasks o3 did not solve, so it says little about the others. The eligibility runs show that the real fix passes and the unfixed code fails; they do not show that a different correct fix passes. The counterexample covers one task, one patch, one run under emulation on an arm64 host, and its record does not show the patch is complete.

reasons: Documented would need only a described procedure. Here the authors report coverage (1,699 samples, three labels each), findings (68.3% filtered) and a limit (overzealous filtering), and the auditor ran executed checks on all 21 tasks, so the level is Checked. It is not Contradicted for the form as a whole: the 18199 defect is a single task, and for the other 20 tasks no record shows a test that rejects a correct fix. The 18199 defect is listed in task_defects. The 2026 audit shows that flawed tests remain in the Verified set at a high rate for hard tasks, which limits trust in the check but is not a shown defect in the other 20 tasks.
missing: The authors' per task annotations for these 21 tasks; a check of each task with a correct fix different from the reference patch; for sympy__sympy-18199, a review of whether the minimal patch is a complete fix.
checks_performed: Read all 21 eligibility records: every FAIL_TO_PASS test failed before the fix and none failed with the real fix
Read the sympy__sympy-18199 counterexample record and compared it with the 2026 post

roles.assistant: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Claude Code subagent), rating form run of 2026-11-08

instructions: Record evidence locations with short quotes, the check performed, its outcome, detection limits, and reasons. The check outcome is the result of the check described in the procedure; state whether the benchmark sources report it or the auditor performed it. A rating without evidence and reasons is incomplete. Missing evidence is not a defect; a defect needs a cited location, and an oracle defect needs an executed counterexample.

task_defects.summary: the only FAIL_TO_PASS test, test_solve_modular, fails for a patch that keeps only the lines for the stated issue (a % p == 0 returns the root 0); the failing assertion concerns composite moduli, which the issue does not mention. The same record states it does not show that this patch is a complete fix, and OpenAI names the task as a too wide test case.
